riley: OK team: hypothetical social hour idea — LLM speed-dating. Each person pitches a short dating profile for a model/component. quick, silly, 1-2 lines. I'll kick it off.

riley: `Name: Quant Q \nAbout me: 8-bit heart, big on compression. Low memory dates only. Will surprise you with smaller footprints.` :sparkles:
marta: `Name: KV (keeps_vibes) \nAbout me: Prefers long conversations. Will ghost you after TTL.` :ghost: :laughing:
tom: `Name: BeamSearch Brad \nAbout me: I always pick the safe option. Not into surprises.` :sweat_smile:
zara_design: Imagining Tinder cards with tiny latency meters :chart_with_upwards_trend: also making a sticker: "I love prefix walks"
infra-bot: psa: do not actually seed KV with secrets, this is a joke. Also prewarm scripts available at `infra/scripts/prewarm.sh` :warning:
marta: prompt idea: "You are a hopeless romantic decoder-only model. Write a 2-line pickup, but only use tokens that rhyme with 'cache'" :thinking_face:
tom: sample: "Hey, I'm your friendly KV stash, let's batch and avoid the crash" :rofl:
riley: we should use this for onboarding slides: slide 5 "culture: we anthropomorphize infra for sanity" :coffee:
zara_design: I'm prototyping a tiny animation where a cache pours coffee and hands devs a warm token :art:
infra-bot: reminder (bot): deploy windows still start at 02:00 UTC. please don't push speculative prewarmers in the 01:50 slot :robot_face:
marta: poll: which persona should we animate? options: Quant Q, KV, BeamSearch Brad, or Decoder Romeo
participants: riley, marta, tom, zara_design, infra-bot
last_message: tom: Decoder Romeo wins in my heart. also can we get merch? :heart:
